messages.subject: Whitcombe - settlement signed, payment instructions
messages.plaintextBody:
Lesley,

Good news - the settlement agreement was signed by both sides today and Ms Bartlett has given the statutory advice and signed her certificate. The claim will be formally withdrawn this week.

To action payment, under the agreement the Company should pay within 21 days of today:
- £108,000 to Mr Whitcombe (we will send his bank details once verified); and
- £15,000 (incl. VAT) to Ashworth Quinn LLP against their invoice.

We'll send the executed agreement and the breakdown of the tax treatment shortly so payroll can apply PAYE correctly to the £78,000 element.

Best wishes,
Tom Gallagher
Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0538

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
